title: Waterjet: add 'waterjet' machine kind, 'Waterjet' tool kind, and cut-data seam

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Add the `waterjet` machine kind and the `Waterjet` tool kind for abrasive-waterjet support.

## Scope

- **Machine kind (`crates/post/src/machine/kind.rs`, `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs`):**
  - Add `Kind::Waterjet` with the `"waterjet"` word in `.mch` files.
  - Require `X` and `Y` linear axes.
  - Allow an optional `Z` axis (unlike `Kind::Plasma`, which requires `Z`).
  - Refuse spindle, live tool, rotary, and milling coolant keys via `NoSpindle` (`crates/post/src/machine/no_spindle.rs`).
  - Keep support for asymmetric bed travel ranges such as `X 0..460` and `Y -305..0` mm (`crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs`, `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs`).
- **Tool kind and cut data (`crates/tools/src/tools.rs`, `crates/tools/src/cutting_rows.rs`):**
  - Add `ToolKind::Waterjet` for a nozzle orifice and kerf stream.
  - Require `rpm == 0` and positive kerf width.
  - Align waterjet `CuttingRow` fields with `#1521` Slice 4: material, thickness, cut feed, kerf, pierce time, abrasive delay, re-pierce time, and pierce method (`stationary`, `dynamic`, `wiggle`).
- **Machine check (`crates/app/src/machine/`):**
  - Check XY travel bounds and XY feed ceilings.
  - Skip Z-depth and spindle RPM checks with clear notes when no Z axis or spindle exists.
  - Admit only `Family::Waterjet` operations on `Kind::Waterjet` machines.

**Done means:** `waterjet` machines parse and validate (`X`/`Y` required, optional `Z`, spindle words refused by name), `ToolKind::Waterjet` enforces `rpm == 0` and kerf > 0 with `#1521`-compatible cut-data fields, machine checks test XY travel and feed without failing on missing Z, and unit tests pin every refusal.

Part of #1525
